2609.30894.title: Training Graph Foundation Models on The Web Graph
2609.30894.paper_summary: We introduce Acacia, a graph foundation model, trained on the web graph. Acacia (i) supports arbitrary feature dimensionalities and semantics without additional training, (ii) supports a wide range of tasks, including node classification, link prediction, node clustering, and graph generation, without additional training, (iii) has in-context learning capabilities, and (iv) does not rely on pretrained LLMs. In particular, existing graph foundation models often require training additional classification heads or feature projectors to accommodate new graphs or new labels, whereas Acacia does not. Moreover, existing graph foundation models often gain their capabilities by being stitched together with pretrained LLMs, whereas Acacia is trained from scratch using only the Common Crawl web graph. This is also an important result because it provides evidence that graph models can acquire emergent capabilities from scratch like LLMs.
2609.30894.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 Acacia，一個基於圖形的基礎模型，訓練於網路圖。Acacia (i) 支援任意的特徵維度和語義，無需額外訓練，(ii) 支援廣泛的任務，包括節點分類、連結預測、節點聚類和圖形生成，無需額外訓練，(iii) 具備上下文學習能力，以及 (iv) 不依賴預訓練的 LLM。特別是，現有的圖形基礎模型通常需要訓練額外的分類頭或特徵投影器，以適應新圖或新標籤，而 Acacia 則不需要。此外，現有的圖形基礎模型通常通過與預訓練的 LLM 組合來獲得其能力，而 Acacia 則是從頭開始訓練，只使用 Common Crawl 網路圖。這也是一個重要的結果，因為它提供了證據，表明圖形模型可以像 LLM 一樣從零開始獲得突現能力。
2609.30894.author: Ryoma Sato et.al.
